# Shipping Policy

## Dispatch time

Orders are dispatched within 2 business days of order confirmation. Orders for customers on credit hold are not dispatched.

## Delivery times

Delivery takes 3 to 5 business days within the same state and 5 to 8 business days elsewhere in the country.

## Shipping charges

Orders above 50,000 ship free. Smaller orders are charged a flat 1,200 shipping fee. Customers may arrange their own pickup from the warehouse at no charge.

## Damaged in transit

Check the delivery before signing. Record any visible damage on the delivery note and contact us within 48 hours.
